case_number: 2025 INSC 357; CIVIL APPEAL NOS. OF 2025 [@ SPECIAL LEAVE PETITION (CIVIL) NOS.12193-12194 OF 2024]

parties.respondent: The Divisional Manager, United India Insurance Co. Ltd. & Others

summary: Motor accident claim; compensation calculation; income assessment of deceased; MACT awarded Rs.25.49 lakhs, High Court reduced to Rs.20.61 lakhs; Supreme Court finds both lower assessments incorrect; evidence of loan, crop sales, milk vending, and tractor use表明 deceased had active role in family enterprises; rejected Rs.8,000 (High Court) and Rs.40,000 (claimants') figures; settled on Rs.15,000 monthly income; revised compensation with 6% interest; legal principles from Sarla Verma and Pranay Sethi applied; enhancement allowed in part.
legal_provisions_cited: Indian Penal Code, 1860 s.279, s.337, s.338, s.304-A
Smt. Sarla Verma v Delhi Transport Corporation, (2009) 6 SCC 121
National Insurance Company Ltd. v Pranay Sethi, (2017) 16 SCC 680
final_judgment: Appeals allowed in part; compensation recalculated based on monthly income of Rs.15,000; High Court's reduction set aside; MACT award modified accordingly; interest at 6% from claim filing till realization.
